title: Two-Timescale Design for Movable Antenna-Enabled Multiuser MIMO Systems

known_settings.small_scale_distribution: independent circular complex Gaussian, mean zero, variance one

ambiguities.description: 29a defines maximum eigenvalue of a real symmetric 2x2 matrix. The printed closed form 29b has minus 4*Psi12^2 instead of plus. No silent substitution is permitted; execution requires an explicit interpretation.

Algorithm 2 names P3.n whereas its text defines P5.n; the displayed constraint reference names a curvature formula rather than the spacing inequality. Execution requires explicit use of the mathematically stated P5.n with spacing inequality (30).
Omega is MxM but S(t) is NxN. Their printed products are undefined for the default N=6,M=5. No invented covariance reduction or replacement Wishart approximation is implemented.
Section II prose writes S*u while the extension explicitly writes S^(1/2)*u for covariance S. The correlated channel implementation is mapped only to (68).

compute_note: An original full run count cannot be inferred without Monte Carlo counts and sweep grids.
